document:0:381:0.text:
... Upon examination, the portrait has been enchanted with a complex magic combining force field magic, elemental magic, and alchemy. Of the three, alchemy is clearly the dominant component.

This complex magic enables the portrait to hold mana, enriching its colors, animating the figure within, and providing basic protection against divination.

Maybe it's not necessary to figure out every single spell in the magic. By preparing a special reagent made from <style="highlight">lumengrass</style>, <style="highlight">red chestnut pollen</style>, and <style="highlight">mutated venom glands</style>, the magic can be revealed in the form of a magic circle...
...
document:0:381:0.source_cn:
……经过判断，画像上被施加了一种混合了力场、元素和炼金的复杂魔法。在这之中，炼金系的术式应该是占据主导地位的……
这种魔法可以让画像储存魔法能量，使画像颜色更加真实，为画中人物增加动态效果，并使这幅画带有基础的反占卜特性。
或许可以避开强行解析术式？用<style="highlight">显影草浓缩液</style>、<style="highlight">红栗花粉</style>和<style="highlight">魔导腺体</style>调配一种魔法术式显影剂，使术式以魔法阵的形式显影出现……
……
